h1: If this is not what you expected, tell us.
intro: We are a small Tricity team, not a national portal, and we would rather refund someone than hold on to money they regret spending. This page says exactly when we refund, how to ask, and what happens when a member behaves badly.

seven.title: Seven days, no argument
seven.p1: Ask within seven days of paying and we refund the membership in full — you do not have to justify it. Write to {{supportEmail}} from the email on your account and say you want a refund.
seven.p2: One exception, and it is the obvious one: if you have already unlocked contact details during those seven days, we deduct those unlocks at ₹199 for three, which is what the top-up costs. Everything else comes back.

after.title: After seven days
after.p1: A membership runs for its full term and we do not refund the unused part of it — the same way a gym membership works. If something has genuinely gone wrong, write to us anyway. We read every message and we have discretion.
after.p2: We will always refund, at any point in the term, if: we removed a feature you paid for, the service was unusable for a sustained period, or you were charged twice.

conduct.title: If a member behaves badly
conduct.p1: Report anyone who harasses you, misrepresents themselves, or asks you for money — there is a report option on every profile and in every conversation. We review reports by hand.
conduct.p2: A member we remove for harassment or fraud does not get a refund. If you were the one harmed and you no longer want to be here because of it, you get one — regardless of how long you have been a member.

ask.title: How to ask, and how long it takes
ask.p1: Email <supportmail>{{supportEmail}}</supportmail> from your registered address with your registered phone number. We reply within two working days.
ask.p2: Approved refunds go back to the original payment method through Razorpay and usually take five to seven working days to appear, depending on your bank. We do not refund to a different account than the one that paid.
ask.p3: What we never do: charge a renewal without asking, keep charging after you cancel, or make you phone somebody to leave. You can delete your account yourself, at any time, <deletelink>from here</deletelink>.
